purpose: MX/inbound SMTP receive and durable local-domain storage

authority.internet_ingress: unauthenticated SMTP is allowed only for configured local recipients
authority.relay: not provided by this service profile
authority.mailbox_classification: verified user signature -> INBOX; unsigned/invalid -> INBOX-UNSIGNED
authority.storage: one authoritative RFC822 object with mailbox membership projection

dependencies: OpenSSL through Foreign Runtime secure.socket provider
activation_gate: local unsigned message persists to INBOX-UNSIGNED
local verified-signed message persists to INBOX
IMAP mailbox projection sees the same stored object
operator_gate: live host install, firewall/DNS/MX and production activation require owner-approved deployment action
